title: Lower density of the weight of a constant-orientation cycle with the integer slice property
statement:
Notation: Hⁿ = μHE[n], ω_n = unitBallVolume n, |α| = covectorEuclideanNorm α for covectors, B_r(x) = ball x r; densities are in [0, ∞] with ofReal.
An admissible representation (μ, ξ) of a current X ∈ 𝒟_k(ℝ^P) consists of a Borel measure μ finite on compact sets and a μ-a.e. strongly measurable field ξ of k-vectors with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ-a.e. and X(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x))dμ(x) for all test k-forms ω.
Y ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) has the integer slice property (ISP) if the following holds for all admissible representations (μ, ξ) of Y and (μ', ξ') of ∂Y and every Lipschitz f : ℝ^P → ℝ: for L¹-a.e. t, all A ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) and B ∈ 𝒟_d(ℝ^P) with A(ω) = ∫_{f<t}ξ(ω)dμ and B(η) = ∫_{f<t}ξ'(η)dμ' for all test forms have ∂A − B integer multiplicity.
Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d + 1, η₀, θ₀ ∈ ℝ, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P, ζ₀ an n-vector (MultiVector P n) and C ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P).
Assume (LD_{η₀}): let C' ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) with ∂C' = 0, μ a Borel measure finite on compact sets with M_W(C') = μ(W) for all open W, and ξ μ-a.e. strongly measurable with |ξ(x)(α)| ≤ |α| μ-a.e. and C'(ω) = ∫ξ(x)(ω(x))dμ(x) for all test n-forms ω. If C' has ISP, then ofReal η₀ ≤ liminf_{r↓0} μ(B_r(x))/(ω_n·ofReal(rⁿ)) for μ-a.e. x.
Assume moreover: θ₀ > 0; ∂C = 0; ν(K) < ∞ for every compact K; M_W(C) = ofReal(θ₀)·ν(W) for every open W; |ζ₀(β)| ≤ |β| for every n-covector β; C(ω) = ∫θ₀ζ₀(ω(y))dν(y) for every test n-form ω; and C has ISP.
Then ofReal(η₀/θ₀) ≤ liminf_{r↓0} ν(B_r(y))/(ω_n·ofReal(rⁿ)) for ν-a.e. y.
